description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectDao class used for data access operations related to projects within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, querying project data, and generating reports using Doctrine ORM. The class interacts with project entities, project activities, project admins, and timesheet items, handling complex filtering, pagination, and report generation logic.

classes.name: ProjectDao
classes.description: A data access object (DAO) class handling database interactions for project-related entities such as projects, project activities, project admins, and timesheet items. It provides various methods for CRUD operations, filtering, report generation, and access control within the project management module.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Persists a Project entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: deleteProjects
methods.description: Marks multiple Project entities as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Project entity by its ID if it is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingProjectIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of existing projects from a list of IDs, excluding deleted ones.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Fetches a list of projects based on filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getProjectsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of projects matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: isProjectNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a project name is already taken within a specific customer, excluding a specified project ID.

methods.name: isProjectAdmin
methods.description: Determines if an employee is a project admin of any active project.

methods.name: getProjectIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of project IDs, optionally including or excluding deleted projects.

methods.name: getProjectIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Returns project IDs accessible to a specific project admin, optionally including deleted projects.

methods.name: hasTimesheetItemsForProject
methods.description: Checks if there are timesheet items associated with a given project.

methods.name: getProjectReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on project report filters.

methods.name: getProjectReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Counts report entries matching project report filters.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration of timesheet items matching report filters for projects.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDetailedReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Gets detailed report data for project activities based on filters.

methods.name: getProjectReportActivityDetailedCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Counts detailed report entries for project activities.

methods.name: getProjectReportActivityDetailedCriteriaList
methods.description: Retrieves detailed report data for project activities.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectActivityDetailedReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration for project activities in detailed reports.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpNumbersForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Returns employee numbers of employees accessible by a project admin.

methods.name: getUnselectableProjectIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of projects that have timesheet items, and thus cannot be unselected.

methods.name: getActivityIdsOfProjectInTimesheetItems
methods.description: Fetches IDs of activities within timesheet items for a specific project.
